Name: Domed Pots and QL - Flower Garden 2 Compatibility
Author: MariesaMist
Description:
This mod gives two options to go about compatibility, Both are in the folder you download, and you PICK ONE

The first Option is to overwrite the Domed Garden Folder, in which you would go to 
[CP] Domed Garden Pot\Data 
Click "Machine" and DELETE
Then move the new Machine folder in to replace it.

The second option is a document you copy and paste into your Domed Garden Pots File, allowing Steller Garden Pots to Grow QL - Flower Garden 2 Plants!
No, It wont grow in any other pot, This took a while to do as it was. I will consider adding them to other pots though, if people really want it. Let me know what kind you use most frequently!
Go to the folder labeled
[CP] Domed Garden Pot\Data 
Then Click "Machine"
There will be a part that says:
[code]                        // Parsnip seeds
                        {
                            "Id": "StellarGardenPot_ParsnipSeeds",
                            "Triggers": [{"Trigger": "ItemPlacedInMachine", "RequiredItemId": "(O)472", "RequiredCount": 999}],
                            "OutputItem": [{"ItemId": "(O)24", "MinStack": 999, "MaxStack": 999, "Quality": 4}], //Parsnip
                            "MinutesUntilReady": 3200 //2 days
                        },
[/code]
Please click at the end of the "}," Line, and hit "ENTER"
Then copy and paste the text in the file you downloaded!
Its that simple!
